mathematics.assertion_tested: Leading X+X- to Phi+Phi- tree amplitude, threshold and finite-p CM sigma v, exact decay ratio and weighted-event moments; reconstruct u*=.02 benchmark and compare four angular integrals plus four explicit density ratios.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: SymPy exact rational/radical identities and Python binary64 finite integrals
mathematics.conventions: hbar=c=1, metric+---; external X+ momentum P1 and final Phi+ momentum K1 define t=(P1-K1)^2. Incoming X+X- and final Phi+Phi- are distinct species. Density n_opposite is per sign, not total.
non_claims: Not a full finite-density reaction network or exhaustive hard-loss channel enumeration.
No cosmological or halo-density theorem, no dense Bose enhancement or inverse hard-population calculation.
Weighted positive number is an emergent NR quantity, not the exactly conserved signed relativistic U1 charge.
